newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY LEAGUE-KIWIS HUMBLE PNG 62-8 IN FIRST TEST.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY LEAGUE-KIWIS HUMBLE PNG 62-8 IN FIRST TEST.

text.p: New Zealand raced in 11 tries to one as they overwhelmed Papua New Guinea 62-8 (halftime 16-2) in the first rugby league test in Rotorua on Saturday.
Centre John Timu, replacement forward Ruben Wiki and winger Richard Barnett each scored two tries in the opening match of the two-test series.
Papua New Guinea competed gamely in the first half but spent much of the time trapped in their own half allowing tries to Barnett, hooker Syd Eru and Timu.
The tourists grew in confidence in the last 10 minutes of the half, the only time they pressured the Kiwi defence, but New Zealand moved up a gear in the second half.
Timu scored his second try in the fifth minute and five-eighth Gene Ngamu stepped through a gap five minutes later to score.
The Kiwis ran in six more tries through Barnett, Tyran Smith, Stephen Kearney, Sean Hoppe and two to Wiki.
The result was a disappointment for Papua New Guinea, who narrowly lost 32-30 at home to Britain last week.
